opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair for flights from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date} (optionally returning {return_date}, with a promo code) and select fares.
steps: Open the Ryanair flight search form
Set 'From' to the origin airport (type it or pick country then city)
Set 'To' to the destination airport (type it or pick country then city)
Open the date picker, go to the right month and pick the departure date
Pick the return date if it's a round trip
Optionally adjust passengers and click Done
Optionally click 'Apply promo code' and enter the code
Click Search
Click Select on the outbound and return fares

instances.values: To Athens, Greece; dates in Apr/May 2023 (2nd and 5th); selected fares
Tel Aviv -> Venice Treviso; May 9 - May 16; selected fares

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and availability notification
opportunities.description: Search Resy for {restaurant/cuisine}, open the restaurant, and set a notify alert for {meal} on {date} for {guests} guests with a preferred time.
steps: Optionally change the location city
Type the restaurant name or cuisine into 'Search restaurants, cuisines, etc.'
Open the matching restaurant
Optionally change the date and the number of guests
Click 'Notify for {meal}'
Optionally set the preferred end time and click Confirm

instances.values: query 'thai' -> Senyai Thai Kitchen; Notify for Dinner; end time 7:00 PM
query 'high tide' -> High Tide; April 17, 2023; 2 guests; Notify for Lunch
Partial: location Sydney; query 'pasta' (stopped before picking a restaurant)

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and availability check
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com Attractions for {destination/attraction} on {date}, open a result, and check its availability.
steps: Click 'Attractions'
Type the destination or attraction into 'Where are you going?' (or browse by region) and pick the suggestion
Click 'Select your dates' and pick the date
Click Search
Optionally sort or filter (e.g. Most popular)
Open the attraction and click 'See availability'
Pick the date and tickets, then click Next

instances.values: Asia -> Kyoto; 25 May 2023; sorted by Most popular; checked availability and clicked Next (paused for other activity in between)
